personas.title: Critical Live-Client Regressions (Skills, PLEX Store, Warp Animation, Chat/Search, Quasar)
personas.description: Execute end-to-end verification of high-risk V24.01 UI & Quasar flows with real state deltas: (1) Open Character Sheet & Skill Plans panel, verify Quasar personal skill plans load without TimeoutException, create and delete a personal skill plan, and queue/reorder a skill in Character Sheet verifying live Skill Queue delta; (2) Open PLEX Vault & New Eden Store (aurumStoreView), verify BalanceRequest succeeds cleanly and inspect an offer; (3) Test Local/Corp chat input, Market/Agency text search, and invalid-input UI error handling without KeyError or Tracebacks; (4) Open SKINR / Structure Browser ('open_window' 'paint_tool' or 'structurebrowser') in space/dock verifying cosmetics/structure UI loads cleanly without TimeoutException; (5) Undock into space, initiate a real-time warp_to (>150 km) WITHOUT clock-skip, and verify ball.mode==3, effects.Warping tunnel FX, and smooth deceleration.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Skills & Plans): Open Skills & Skill Plans, create then delete a personal skill plan, queue/update a skill in the UI Skill Queue, and verify live queue_len / UI update without exceptions.

Checkpoint 2 (Quasar Store & Cosmetics): Open PLEX Vault / New Eden Store (aurumStoreView) verifying BalanceRequest succeeds without timeout, and open SKINR / Structure Browser ('open_window' 'paint_tool' or 'structurebrowser') cleanly.

Checkpoint 3 (Chat/Search UI & Realtime Warp): Exercise chat/search input submission cleanly without UI tracebacks, then undock and initiate real-time warp_to (>150 km) verifying saw_mode3 and saw_fx_warping.

personas.title: Newbro Fitting, Inventory & Station Services (Undock Verified)
personas.description: Complete end-to-end Station, Inventory, and Fitting workflows with verified item & attribute deltas: (1) Reuse existing hangar ships/modules or buy tactical frigate/fitting hardware from Regional Market (Rifter 587 / Catalyst 16240, 5MN Microwarpdrive I 434, 200mm AutoCannon I 486 or Light Ion Blaster I 563, Medium Shield Booster I 10836); (2) Open Inventory (inventory) while docked, stack/split an item stack (e.g. Tritanium 34), move items between Item Hangar and Ship Cargo Hold, and verify OnItemChange / widget updates; (3) Open Fitting window (fitting), fit/toggle a module online/offline and verify CPU/Powergrid stats update live, then undock into space and activate the fitted propulsion/repair module verifying Ship HUD rack & ship speed/capacitor delta; (4) Dock and exercise Station Services (Repair Shop, Insurance, Medical Clone / Home Station) plus AIR Daily Goals claim/progress.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Inventory Stack & Transfer): Open Inventory while docked, locate or purchase a stackable item (e.g. Tritanium 34), split the stack, move items between Hangar and Cargo Hold, and verify live UI update.

Checkpoint 2 (Fitting -> Undock Verification): Open Fitting, equip/online available propulsion & combat modules (e.g. 5MN Microwarpdrive I 434, 200mm AutoCannon I 486, Medium Shield Booster I 10836), verify Dogma CPU/PG delta, then undock and cycle the fitted propulsion/shield module in space.
Checkpoint 3 (Station Services & AIR): Dock, verify Repair/Insurance/Medical Clone UI panels open without error, and inspect/claim available AIR Opportunities / Daily Goals.

personas.title: End-to-End Mining Loop (Belt Warp -> Laser Cycle -> Ore Yield -> Ledger -> Reprocess)
personas.description: Run the complete EVE Online Mining & Resource Harvesting loop through verified inventory/wallet/ledger checkpoints: (1) Ensure Mining (3386), Mining Frigate (32918), and Reprocessing (3385) skills are trained (via Skill Sheet / Market skillbooks if needed), board Venture (32880) or ship with an online Miner I (483) / Civilian Miner (3651); (2) Undock, warp_to an Asteroid Belt in system (visible in Overview / space.nearby_balls / solar system context menu), approach an asteroid (e.g. Veldspar 1230) within <10 km, lock_target, and activate_module on the mining laser; (3) Observe laser beam FX and complete at least one cycle verifying mined Veldspar (1230) arrives in Cargo/Mining Hold (open_neocom 'mininghold' or 'inventory'); (4) Open Mining Ledger ('miningledger') and verify personal/corp mining entries render cleanly; (5) Dock at station, open Reprocessing Plant ('reprocessing'), load mined Veldspar (1230), inspect quote (GetQuotes), and click Reprocess verifying ore consumes and Tritanium (34) is delivered into Hangar.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Undock & Asteroid Belt Lock): Verify Venture (32880) / Miner I (483) fit in hangar, undock, warp_to an Asteroid Belt, approach an asteroid (<10 km), and lock the asteroid.
Checkpoint 2 (Cycle & Ore Deposit): Activate the mining laser (activate_module / F1), sustain a cycle, and verify mined Veldspar (1230) appears in Mining Hold / Cargo Hold via OnItemChange.

Checkpoint 3 (Ledger & Reprocess to Tritanium): Open Mining Ledger ('miningledger'), then dock, open Reprocessing Plant ('reprocessing'), load Veldspar (1230), quote and Reprocess into Tritanium (34) verifying item consumption & mineral credit.

personas.title: Navigation, Stargate Jumps, Combat/Drones & Probe Scanning
personas.description: Test complete in-space mechanics across multiple solar systems: (1) Undock and verify sub-warp Destiny commands (approach, orbit, keep_at_range, Align, Stop) change ego.mode and speed_mps properly; (2) Test combat weapons (Light Ion Blaster I 563 / 200mm AutoCannon I 486) and Drones (Hobgoblin I 2454) against a locked NPC/asteroid-belt target, verifying OnGodmaShipEffect and target damage_state delta; (3) Perform a multi-system Cross-System Stargate Jump roundtrip using action 'jump_gate' (e.g., from Urlen 30000139 via 'Stargate (Perimeter)' 50000549 or 'Stargate (Kisogo)' 50000547, verify state_diff.solar_system_changed and ballpark re-bind, then 'jump_gate' back to Urlen); (4) Open Directional Scanner (dscan / ALT+D) and Probe Scanner (probe / ALT+P), ensure Core Probe Launcher I (17938) + Core Scanner Probe I (30013) are fitted/loaded, launch probes and run a Scan/Analyze sweep.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Sub-warp & Combat/Drones): Undock, verify Approach/Orbit/Stop speed & mode deltas, then lock an NPC/asteroid-belt target and cycle fitted weapons (486/563) and/or Drones (2454) verifying damage_state or effect scatter.

Checkpoint 2 (Cross-System Stargate Jump Roundtrip): Use 'jump_gate' on a neighboring Stargate in Urlen (e.g. Stargate (Perimeter) 50000549 or Stargate (Kisogo) 50000547), verify solar_system_changed & clean new-system ballpark, then 'jump_gate' back to Urlen.

Checkpoint 3 (D-Scan & Probe Scanning): Open Directional Scanner ('dscan') and run a scan, then open Probe Scanner ('probe' / ALT+P) with Core Probe Launcher I (17938) + Core Scanner Probe I (30013), launch probes, and click Analyze verifying cosmic signatures/anomalies list cleanly.

personas.title: Market Search/Buy/Cancel, Contracts Create & Industry Start/Deliver
personas.description:
Replace shallow window inspection with transactional completion checkpoints while docked: (1) Regional Market ('market'): find an editable search box (clickable_widgets with editable=true), use type_text with '
' (e.g. 'Tritanium
' or 'Rifter
'), inspect Price History & Order Book, buy an item or place a Buy/Sell order AND cancel an active order verifying wallet_state.isk_balance / OnAccountChange and hangar item delta; (2) Wallet ('wallet'): check ISK & PLEX balances, Journal, Transactions, and OnAccountChange delta after a market transaction; (3) Contracts ('contracts'): use type_text search/filter on public/my contracts AND run Create Contract wizard for an Item Exchange contract (when creating a Public Item Exchange contract without requesting items in return, set Price >= 1000 ISK so V24 accepts it; verify submission in My Contracts and Delete your test contract afterward so the L0 1-contract slot stays free); (4) Industry ('industry'): ensure a blueprint (e.g. Rifter Blueprint 691 + minerals) is in hangar (stack/reuse existing hangar items or buy from Market), Start a manufacturing job, inspect Facilities/Jobs, and Deliver any completed job verifying output item delivery via OnItemChange.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Market Search -> Order/Buy -> Cancel): Open Regional Market, use type_text on the search input ('Tritanium\n' or 'Veldspar\n'), view history/orders, execute a market buy or place & cancel a market order, verifying isk_delta & item delivery.

Checkpoint 2 (Contracts Search & Creation): Open Contracts, test type_text search filtering, complete Create Contract flow for an Item Exchange contract (set Price >= 1000 ISK if Public with no requested return items), verify active contract list update in My Contracts, and Delete the test contract afterward so the single slot stays free.

Checkpoint 3 (Industry Start -> Jobs/Facilities -> Deliver): Open Industry, load a blueprint job, Start manufacturing (verify fee isk_delta), inspect active Jobs/Facilities, and Deliver any completed job cleanly.

Checkpoint 2 (Mail & Chat Composition): Open Mail ('mail'), compose and send a self-addressed test EVEMail using type_text, and send a local/corp chat line via type_text ('...\n') verifying message appears.
Checkpoint 3 (Fleet, Agency & SKINR): Form a Fleet, test Fleet Broadcast while undocked (and verify Agency Exploration/Encounters/Resource Harvesting tabs & SKINR open/close cleanly).

personas.title: Adversarial Inputs, Shortcuts, Double-Click, Right-Click & Mid-Warp Rejection
personas.description: Stress-test UI edge cases, keyboard shortcuts, input widgets, eveui double-click, and protocol race guards rather than repeatedly closing windows: (1) Keyboard Shortcuts & Focus: cycle through press_key shortcuts (ALT+C, ALT+F, ALT+R, ALT+G, ALT+W, ALT+N, ALT+P, ALT+D, F9, F10, TAB, RETURN, CTRL+SPACE, ESCAPE) verifying windows open/focus/close without tracebacks; (2) Editable Input Fuzz & Submit: find editable=true fields via type_text, test unicode, negative/zero numbers, very long search strings, and '\n' submission checking clean rejection or filtering; (3) eveui double_click & Right-Click Context Menus: test click_widget with double_click=true (cards/inventory -> Show Info) and right_click=true on ships, inventory stacks, overview rows, and fitted modules; (4) Mid-Warp Rejection Stress: undock, initiate warp_to (>150 km), and while mode==3 / warping test mid-warp dock/jump/module edge behavior verifying clean error handling without state desync or client crash.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Keyboard Shortcuts & Focus Navigation): Exercise press_key shortcuts (ALT+F, ALT+C, ALT+R, ALT+W, ALT+P, ALT+D, ALT+N, TAB, RETURN, CTRL+SPACE, ESCAPE) verifying responsive window/ship/focus transitions with zero exceptions.

Checkpoint 2 (Editable Inputs, Double-Click & Context Menus): Test type_text edge cases (unicode, long query, '\n' submit), click_widget with double_click=true on cards/items (Show Info / Fit), and right_click context menus across Hangar & Space Overview.

Checkpoint 3 (Mid-Warp Protocol Guard): Undock, start warp_to (>150 km), attempt mid-warp command edges (sub-warp stop/approach or premature dock) while warping, and confirm graceful rejection/recovery and undamaged ship/session state.

personas.title: Upwell Structures: Market Acquisition, Stargate Travel, Deep-Space Launch, Structure Browser & Standup Fitting Simulation
personas.description: End-to-end Upwell structure player workflow: (1) Prerequisites & Market Acquisition: ensure the pilot belongs to a player corporation (create one via Corporation window if in NPC starter corp), check Anchoring (3443) + Corporation Management (3731) skills, sell PLEX on Regional Market if more ISK is needed, and purchase an Astrahus (35832) + Astrahus Upwell Quantum Core (56201) (or Raitaru 35825 + Raitaru Upwell Quantum Core 56204), Standup Cloning Center I (35894) / Standup Market Hub I (35892), Fuel Blocks (4051/4247), and an industrial hauler with cargo space; (2) Stargate Jump & Deep-Space Anchor Launch: travel via 'jump_gate' to Perimeter (30000144) or Maurasi (30000140) — NEVER attempt to deploy in Jita 30000142 where static data raises CantDeployBlocked — warp toward a distant planet/stargate and press CTRL+SPACE Stop Ship mid-warp for a deep-space spot >1,000 km from stations/gates, right-click the structure in cargo -> 'Launch for Corporation' to deploy AnchorVulnerable; (3) Structure Browser, Access Lists & Online Inspection: open Structure Browser ('structurebrowser') & Profiles/Access Lists, inspect any existing online Upwell structures (dock/tether/service checks when available); (4) Standup Fitting Simulation: open Fitting Simulation ('fitting') to fit Astrahus (35832) / Raitaru (35825) + Standup Market Hub I (35892) / Standup Cloning Center I (35894) + Fuel Blocks verifying Dogma stats cleanly.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Corp, Market & Gate to Perimeter): Ensure player corp membership, inspect Anchoring (3443) / Corp Management (3731), acquire Raitaru (35825) / Astrahus (35832) + Quantum Core (56204/56201) + Standup module + hauler via Jita Market, and travel via 'jump_gate' to Perimeter (30000144).

Checkpoint 2 (Deep-Space Launch & Structure Browser): In Perimeter (30000144) >1,000 km from stations/gates (mid-warp CTRL+SPACE drop), deploy via 'Launch for Corporation' ('AnchorVulnerable') if hauled, and inspect Structure Browser ('structurebrowser') / Access Profiles cleanly.

Checkpoint 3 (Standup Fitting Simulation & Return): Simulate Upwell Structure + Standup Market Hub I (35892) / Standup Cloning Center I (35894) loadout in Fitting Simulation, inspect any online Upwell structure if present, and return to Jita 4-4 via 'jump_gate'.
